question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing goalkeeper, Bob is playing left midfielder, Claire is playing left back, Dave is playing striker, Eve is playing cheerleader, Fred is playing right midfielder, and Gertrude is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Eve and Fred trade positions. Then, Alice and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Eve and Fred trade positions. Then, Fred and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Fred and Dave trade positions. Finally, Dave and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) goalkeeper
(B) left midfielder
(C) left back
(D) striker
(E) cheerleader
(F) right midfielder
(G) right winger
solution:
Player order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: goalkeeper, left midfielder, left back, striker, cheerleader, right midfielder, right winger.
1. Bob and Dave swap: goalkeeper, striker, left back, left midfielder, cheerleader, right midfielder, right winger.
2. Eve and Fred swap: goalkeeper, striker, left back, left midfielder, right midfielder, cheerleader, right winger.
3. Alice and Gertrude swap: right winger, striker, left back, left midfielder, right midfielder, cheerleader, goalkeeper.
4. Eve and Fred swap: right winger, striker, left back, left midfielder, cheerleader, right midfielder, goalkeeper.
5. Fred and Gertrude swap: right winger, striker, left back, left midfielder, cheerleader, goalkeeper, right midfielder.
6. Fred and Dave swap: right winger, striker, left back, goalkeeper, cheerleader, left midfielder, right midfielder.
7. Dave and Bob swap: right winger, goalkeeper, left back, striker, cheerleader, left midfielder, right midfielder.
Dave is playing striker, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
